title: 生成质量评估 XY 网格

standard.summary: 训后一次：X=已保存的 epoch/step 产品权重，Y=预览测试组（或验证提示词）；输出 quality_xy_grid.png。中间保存越多 X 轴越密；仅最终权重时也是 1 列网格。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Once after training: X = the saved per-epoch/per-step product weights, Y = the preview test groups (or the validation prompts); it writes quality_xy_grid.png. The more intermediate saves there are the denser the X axis; with only the final weights it is still a one-column grid.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 训后一次：X=已保存的 epoch/step 产品权重，Y=预览测试组（或验证提示词）；输出 quality_xy_grid.png。中间保存越多 X 轴越密；仅最终权重时也是 1 列网格。

advanced_en.principle: Once after training: X = saved epoch/step artifact weights, Y = preview groups (or validation prompts); outputs quality_xy_grid.png. More intermediate saves make the X axis denser; with only the final weight it is still a 1-column grid.
